DRIVE, REVERSE, ROTATE and the CORRIDOR_ States. Dashed grey boxes are States shown in other pictures; red = fault.

Runs twice: corridor = 1 ends in CORRIDOR_REVERSE, then CORRIDOR_TURN; corridor = 2 ends in CORRIDOR_STOP. A corridor ends on the front cliff, not on distance. DRIVE ignores the ledge-side bumper and the storage-
wall-side cliff; REVERSE, ROTATE and the CORRIDOR_ States ignore bumper and cliff. Only B1 | wheeldrop faults here.
